text_block_list.text:
One day off, while walking in front of the 
station with Vodka—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!? Th-That's awesooome...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer! Check out those old guys 
over there!

In the direction Vodka was looking, a 
tough-looking group clad in leather 
jackets was chatting away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The rider jackets they're wearing are 
genuine vintage from half a century ago!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Those star-shaped studs, no mistake about 
it! That's the exact thing my pops wanted 
so badly...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Holy crap, that's insanely cool!!!!
choice_data_list: So you like rider jackets, huh?
You like rider jackets, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Because it's super freaking cool!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops loves leather rider jackets too, so I 
borrow his to wear every now and then, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Real leather really is on a completely 
different level of comfort! The more you 
break it in, the more character it gets, 
y'know? You get what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Well, the one I've got is just cheap 
synthetic leather, though.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course I love that one too. But the 
real deal just hits different, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Man, I want that...
choice_data_list: Take what you want by force...

If you persistently layer what you have on 
hand...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? What kind of nonsense are you 
talking?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As if I'd ever do something so totally 
uncool!!

Even if it was a joke, I told him that if 
he was that curious, he should just call 
out to them and ask to take a look...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~...? Wouldn't it be rude to just call 
out to them outta nowhere...?
choice_data_list:
As long as you're polite, it should be 
fine.
As long as you're polite, you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, but like... What am I even supposed 
to say...?"

...She suddenly became fidgety. It seems 
she's shy around people she doesn't know. 
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Man in Leather Jacket A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you little ladies over there. You've 
been glancing at us for a while... Need 
something from us?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Uh, umm, well...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! That jacket... It's an early model 
from BOT Inc., isn't it!?

The result of plucking up the courage to 
speak to them—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaaa~! It's in crazy good condition! 
It's still super shiny, too!

text_block_list.name: Man in Leather Jacket A
text_block_list.text:
Right? You sure know what to look for, 
missy!

Vodka had completely hit it off with the 
group in leather jackets.

text_block_list.name: Man in Leather Jacket B
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, wanna try wearing my jacket? It 
feels absolutely amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! I'll wear it, I totally 
wanna wear it!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa~~! Man, this weight feels damn 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, is it cool if I take a photo? I wanna 
brag to my dad!

Vodka was utterly thrilled as they 
continued to chat excitedly about hardcore 
fashion for a while after.

"It'll definitely look just as cool as 
theirs. When I gave that advice..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right. You're totally 
right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"All I gotta do is wear it a ton and break 
it in to give it that same kind of 
character!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, decided! I'm gonna take my time and 
make this the ultimate rider jacket!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll forge true, authentic cool with these 
very hands...!
Vodka was all fired up, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but I wonder how much time it's 
gonna take.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know! As a quick fix, how about we just 
leave it out in the rain!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Beatin' the crap outta it's gotta be the 
fastest way to bring out the flavor!
choice_data_list:
I'm not so sure that's what true coolness 
is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I guess so, huh? Figures...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pops always said, 'Some things are cool 
precisely because they take time to 
mature.'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still... just waiting around aimlessly 
isn't my style!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer. Let's tear down the 
road so hard that our leather jackets get 
covered in dirt—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—I'm gonna carve out my way of life. 
Hardcore...!
